operator_question: What exact facility account asset interval or audience can this command change?
required_record: stable resource key and collision domain
hard_stop: Resource identity or collision domain is ambiguous
fictional_example: Harbor Pine Storage Gate 2 calendar from 14:00 to 15:00; entirely fictional
claim_boundary: A resolved key does not prove authority or safety

operator_question: Can this proposal be distinguished from every retry and every new intent?
required_record: proposal ID trace ID actor workflow and build version
hard_stop: Proposal identity or build version is missing
claim_boundary: Identity does not prove correctness

operator_question: Is the intended effect exact and machine-readable?
required_record: command type parameters intended effect and intent hash
hard_stop: Effect is free form incomplete or internally inconsistent
evidence_to_close: validated command schema and intent hash
fictional_example: Restrict fictional Gate 2 access for one hour
claim_boundary: Schema validity does not establish permission

operator_question: Which source governs the state this command will change?
required_record: source ID source owner and read method
hard_stop: No approved governing source is named
claim_boundary: A governing source can still be stale unavailable or wrong

operator_question: Which exact state version supported the proposal and approval?
required_record: expected version value or hash and observed_at
hard_stop: Expected version is absent or cannot be compared
claim_boundary: Version identity does not establish factual accuracy

operator_question: Does the expected version still match immediately before commitment?
required_record: current version and compare result
hard_stop: Current version differs or cannot be read
claim_boundary: A passed precondition does not clear other conflicts

operator_question: Which policy version governs the command and its collision rules?
required_record: policy ID version effective period and scope
hard_stop: Policy is missing expired conflicting or outside scope
claim_boundary: A policy reference is not legal or regulatory advice

operator_question: Who may authorize this effect for this resource and consequence?
required_record: authority class approver identity scope and expiration
hard_stop: Approver lacks scope or approval expired
claim_boundary: Approval is not execution or outcome

operator_question: What is the highest reachable operating effect?
required_record: consequence tier affected parties dependent automation and prohibited effects
hard_stop: Consequence is unknown or exceeds the workflow ceiling
claim_boundary: Classification does not predict harm or benefit

operator_question: Does this collision domain require temporary exclusive technical control?
required_record: lease key holder purpose acquired_at renew_at expires_at
hard_stop: Required lease is missing expired or held by another actor
claim_boundary: A lease coordinates execution but does not grant business authority

operator_question: Can the destination reject work from an expired or replaced holder?
required_record: monotonic epoch or fencing value and destination check
hard_stop: Destination cannot distinguish stale holder work where required
claim_boundary: An epoch does not prevent every delayed side effect

operator_question: Will a retry repeat the same intent without creating another effect?
required_record: idempotency key retention rule first result and retry behavior
hard_stop: Key is missing reused for another intent or not honored on the path
claim_boundary: API idempotency does not prove exactly-once business outcome

operator_question: What commands proposals and provider calls already target this domain?
required_record: open command inventory states and timestamps
hard_stop: In-flight work cannot be enumerated
claim_boundary: No observed work is not proof that no work exists

operator_question: Is this a duplicate stale-state incompatible-effect scope-overlap or authority conflict?
required_record: conflict class conflicting IDs and rule applied
hard_stop: Conflict is unclassified or policy has no disposition
claim_boundary: Classification does not resolve ambiguity by itself

operator_question: Does a qualified person receive the smallest decision with the full evidence packet?
required_record: decision question proposals sources versions policies approvals effects deadline and allowed choices
hard_stop: Reviewer lacks evidence authority time or a safe choice
evidence_to_close: signed bounded decision or explicit denial
fictional_example: Fictional incident owner chooses a non-overlapping window
claim_boundary: Human review does not erase system design responsibility

operator_question: Did the exact authorized command version enter the exact provider path once?
required_record: command ID version attempt ID destination and timestamp
hard_stop: Executed bytes or parameters differ from authorization
allowed_disposition: stop dependent work and open incident
claim_boundary: A provider response is not governing readback

operator_question: What narrow state did the provider acknowledge?
required_record: provider reference response state and acceptance meaning
hard_stop: Receipt is missing ambiguous or treated as operating completion
claim_boundary: Acceptance does not prove application delivery or customer effect

operator_question: Does a fresh independent read show the intended state and new version?
required_record: readback source query time value or hash and version
hard_stop: Readback fails disagrees or cannot be performed
claim_boundary: A digital readback may not establish a physical condition

operator_question: Are dependent commands messages and exceptions consistent with the observed state?
required_record: dependency inventory dispositions residuals owner and next review
hard_stop: Required dependency is failed unknown or unresolved
fictional_example: Fictional recovery proposal rebuilt against version 413
claim_boundary: Reconciliation is bounded to enumerated dependencies

operator_question: Can the command close without collapsing authorization acceptance application and reconciliation?
required_record: final state closure authority evidence packet and retention class
hard_stop: Any required state or evidence is missing
allowed_disposition: keep open or close with named residual if policy allows
fictional_example: Fictional command reconciled; no claimed real outcome
claim_boundary: Closure is not publication coverage indexing recognition or proof of architecture effectiveness
